text.p: Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG said on Tuesday it expects net profit in 1997 to exceed 1996's 417 million Swiss francs.
"For 1997, we again expect an improvement in the group results compared with 1996," Theodor Tschopp, chief executive of Alusuisse, said in the text of a statement prepared for a news conference.
Chief financial officer Sergio Marchionne, designated CEO, also said that a substantial amount of capital which has been used for expansion is of a medium- to long-term nature.
He said in prepared remarks that the resulting impact of these investments would only be visible on earnings by 1998 at the earliest.

Commenting on Alusuisse's unchanged dividend, Marchionne also said the dividend policy was especially valid in 1997, as capital expenditures are expected to result in cash spending that exceeds 800 million Swiss francs.
